rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 12 credits directly related to delivery of OT services; up to 10 may relate to the licensee's current or anticipated professional role. Approved providers include AMA, ANA, AOTA and AOTA-approved providers, APTA, ASHA, IACET, RESNA, TOTA, state OT associations and OT regulatory agencies; credits per the Activity Table in Rule 1150-02-.12(12) (e.g. local presentations 1 per hour, max 12; Level I fieldwork 1 per student, Level II 1 per week per student, max 12 total).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial licensure by examination: meeting the licensure requirements counts as compliance for the initial period.
rules.carryover: Up to 4 excess credits may be carried to the next two-year period, but not credits on ethics or Tennessee law/rules.
rules.audit_note: Certify completion at renewal; keep documentation 5 years and provide it within 45 days of a Board request. False certification may lead to discipline.

topics.who: AOTA Code of Ethics or other OT-related ethics; counts toward the 24

rules.legal_basis: Tenn. Comp. R. & Regs. 1150-02-.12 (rev. January 2022); T.C.A. §63-13-204(d)
rules.notes: Since Jan 1, 2022 credits are counted for the 24 months before the renewal month (rule text also refers to the two calendar years before the renewal year); the renewal cycle runs from the first day of the birth month. Waivers for documented illness, disability or undue hardship.
